name: jnv
description: jnv — interactive JSON viewer and filter. Navigate JSON structures with jq-like filtering. Non-interactive mode with --raw.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/ynqa/jnv/releases/download/v0.7.1/jnv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz && tar xf jnv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz && sudo mv jnv /usr/local/bin/ && rm jnv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz

commands.description: jnv — interactive JSON viewer and filter. Navigate JSON structures with jq-like filtering. Non-interactive mode with --raw.
